name: cloudtak-plugin-aleph
description: CloudTAK plugin — Aleph for TAK area capture (thin client of the Aleph capture service)
//: Not built standalone: CloudTAK compiles plugins inside its own web build, which supplies vue, maplibre-gl, @tabler/icons-vue and @tak-ps/cloudtak. `npm run check` copies this plugin into a CloudTAK checkout (CLOUDTAK_DIR) and runs CloudTAK's own vue-tsc + eslint — the exact gate its Docker build enforces.
